description.zh: 文明演化的流程定义骨架（Phase D 草案）。基于口播稿与英文规则书，先建立 Setup、4 时代 × 8 阶段、终局计分的整体流程；具体 action/trigger/condition 细节在 concepts.json 中补全。
description.en: Flow definition skeleton for Civolution (Phase D draft). Based on the Chinese script and English rulebook; establishes Setup, 4 eras × 8 phases, and final scoring. Detailed actions/triggers/conditions will be filled in concepts.json.

description.zh: 游戏设置阶段，分为公共设置和个人设置。
description.en: Game setup phase, divided into public setup and player setup.

description.zh: 拼接分轨形成外框，摆放进程版图和流程版图，组成公共版图；将 8 块大陆板块随机排列铺满计分轨内部的 5×3 网格，形成大陆。
description.en: Assemble the score-track frame and place the progress and sequence boards to form the public board; randomly arrange the 8 continent tiles to fill the 5×3 grid inside the score track frame, forming the continent.

description.zh: 将 24 块地点板块背面朝上随机放在大陆的地点格中。
description.en: Place the 24 site tiles face down on the site spaces of the continent.

description.zh: 将进程版图和流程版图分别放置在公共版图两侧。
description.en: Place the progress board and sequence board on either side of the public board.

description.zh: 将阶段标记放到流程版图阶段序列的阶段一位置。
description.en: Place the phase indicator on phase 1 of the sequence board's phase sequence.

description.zh: 将天气标记放到流程版图天气轨的适中位置。
description.en: Place the weather indicator on a moderate space of the weather gauge.

description.zh: 洗混事件牌后抽出 4 张，背面朝上放在流程版图事件牌格上，其余放回盒子。
description.en: Shuffle event cards, draw 4, and place them face down on the event card spaces; return the rest to the box.

description.zh: 将五种研究牌分别洗混后形成供应堆。
description.en: Shuffle the five types of research cards into separate supply decks.

description.zh: 洗混初始标记牌和初始芯片牌备用。
description.en: Shuffle the starting marker deck and starting chip deck.

description.zh: 随机抽取 4 张计分板块正面朝上放入时代计分区。
description.en: Draw 4 scoring tiles and place them face up in the era scoring area.

description.zh: 随机抽取 3 张计分板块按图标背面朝上覆盖终局计分区。
description.en: Draw 3 scoring tiles and place them point-side up over the final scoring area.

description.zh: 将若干一百分指示物翻面作为阻挡标记覆盖不可用区域，剩余作为供应堆。
description.en: Flip some 100-point tokens as blocking tokens to cover unavailable areas; the rest form the supply.

description.zh: 将若干狩猎指示物翻面作为阻挡标记覆盖不可用营地，剩余作为供应堆。
description.en: Flip some hunting tokens as blocking tokens to cover unavailable campsites; the rest form the supply.

description.zh: 拿取玩家数量 +1 的白骰子和粉骰子，放到进程版图供应区。
description.en: Take player_count + 1 activation dice and fate dice, place them in the progress board supply.

description.zh: 随机抽取若干目标芯片正面朝上放到目标芯片展示区，剩余放回袋子。
description.en: Draw goal chips and place them face up in the goal chip display; return the rest to the bag.

description.zh: 随机抽取若干收入芯片正面朝上放到收入芯片展示区，剩余放回袋子。
description.en: Draw income chips and place them face up in the income chip display; return the rest to the bag.

description.zh: 随机抽取若干属性芯片正面朝上放到属性芯片展示区，剩余放回袋子。
description.en: Draw attribute chips and place them face up in the attribute chip display; return the rest to the bag.

description.zh: 将所有材料板块背面朝上按颜色随机放到大陆板块材料格上；标有初始字样的翻至正面朝上。
description.en: Place all material tiles face down on the continent's material spaces by color randomly; flip those marked 'initial' face up.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿取 15 个主模组并翻至等级一面，放入控制台模组区。
description.en: Each player takes 15 main modules, flips them to level I, and places them in the module area.

description.zh: 每位玩家从游戏盒中拿取 6 个白骰子，分别翻至 ⚀⚁⚂⚃⚄⚅ 六个面，放到控制台骰子区对应点数格上。
description.en: Each player takes 6 activation dice from the game box, sets them to show each value 1-6, and places each on the corresponding dice space of their console.

description.zh: 每位玩家从游戏盒中拿取 1 个粉骰子放在控制台旁边备用。
description.en: Each player takes 1 fate die from the game box and places it beside their console.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿取层级四板块和层级五板块，未激活面朝上放到控制台对应位置。
description.en: Each player takes stage-4 and stage-5 tiles, inactive side up, and places them on the console.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿取所有聚落、农场、船、圆片和部落放到控制台对应位置，并在船上放两个标记。
description.en: Each player takes all settlements, farms, boats, discs, and tribes to their console; place two markers on boats.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿取 1 个分数标记放到计分轨 0 分位置。
description.en: Each player takes 1 score marker and places it on the score track at 0.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿取 1 个恩惠标记放到 <favor_of_ager_track> 起始位置。
description.en: Each player takes 1 favor marker and places it on the <favor_of_ager_track> start.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿取 1 个进程标记放到科技轨 0 格。
description.en: Each player takes 1 progress marker and places it on the technology track at 0.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿取 1 个进程标记放到声望轨 0 格。
description.en: Each player takes 1 progress marker and places it on the prestige track at 0.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿取 1 个进程标记放到知识轨 0 格。
description.en: Each player takes 1 progress marker and places it on the knowledge track at 0.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿取 1 个进程标记放到建设轨 0 格。
description.en: Each player takes 1 progress marker and places it on the construction track at 0.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿取 1 个进程标记放到文化轨 0 格。
description.en: Each player takes 1 progress marker and places it on the culture track at 0.

description.zh: 每位玩家将 2 个部落直立放到两个初始区域中不带篝火的空置营地。
description.en: Each player places 2 tribes upright on empty non-campfire campsites in the two initial territories.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿 6 个标记：2 个放到大陆两个初始区域中营地以外位置，4 个放到控制台重置列顶部。
description.en: Each player takes 6 markers: 2 to non-campsite spaces in the two initial territories, 4 to the reset column top of the console.

description.zh: 决定起始玩家，获得起始纪念碑。
description.en: Determine the starting player, who receives the starting monolith.

description.zh: 每位玩家抽 3 张初始标记牌，选 1 张获得上面标记，其余放回盒子。
description.en: Each player draws 3 starting marker cards, chooses 1 to gain its markers, returns the rest to the box.

description.zh: 翻开玩家数量 +1 张初始芯片牌，每张贴一张目标芯片；从起始玩家右手边玩家开始逆时针选一张，将目标芯片放入目标区，模组翻面至等级二，牌塞入收入区成为首个收入芯片。
description.en: Reveal player_count + 1 starting chip cards, each with a goal chip; draft them counter-clockwise, place goal chip, upgrade module, and slide card under console as first income chip.

description.zh: 每位玩家从五个研究牌堆各抽两张，每种选一张保留，另一张放回牌堆底。
description.en: Each player draws 2 cards from each of the 5 research decks, keeps 1 of each type, returns the other to the bottom of its deck.

description.zh: 游戏共进行 4 个时代，每个时代包含 8 个阶段。
description.en: The game consists of 4 eras, each with 8 phases.

description.zh: 阶段一：新的卡牌。翻开事件牌堆顶部一张（覆盖上时代的事件牌），显示本时代天气变化方向和事件效果。然后翻开 5 个背面朝下研究牌堆各顶部一张，放到对应的正面朝上研究牌堆上（第一时代新建堆，后续覆盖上时代卡牌）。
description.en: Phase 1: New Cards. Reveal the top card of the face-down event stack (covering the previous era's event card), showing this era's weather change direction and event effect. Then reveal the top card from each of the 5 face-down research stacks onto the corresponding face-up research stack (forming new stacks in era 1, covering the previous card thereafter).

description.zh: 阶段二：新的目标。从起始玩家开始顺时针，每位玩家可选择从展示区拿取一枚目标芯片安装到目标列，或跳过。随后补满展示区空位。
description.en: Phase 2: New Goals. Starting with the start player and going clockwise, each player may take a goal chip from the display and install it in the goal column, or pass. Then refill empty display spaces.

description.zh: 阶段三：额外收获。从起始玩家开始顺时针，每位玩家选择一个有自己部落的区域，从该区域可产出的三种材料中选择一种获得一个，放入对应仓库。
description.en: Phase 3: Extra Harvest. Starting with the start player and going clockwise, each player chooses a territory containing their tribe, selects one of the three materials it produces, and gains one into the corresponding storage.

description.zh: 阶段四：行动阶段。阶段标记从第一个黄色 reset space 开始。从起始玩家顺时针轮流转，每回合必须二选一：激活一个模组（支付恰好 2 个对应点数的白骰子或计划/焦点标记）或执行 Reset（前提：当前骰子区白骰子不超过 3 个）。Reset 分三步——A: 沿黄色箭头推动阶段标记到下一个 reset space（若到达红色 reset end space 则触发行动阶段结束）；B: 回收已使用的骰子并全部重掷；C: 将最左侧重置标记移入 idea space 或 food space。阶段标记到达红色格后，先补完当前轮，所有玩家再执行最后一轮完整回合，由起始玩家右手边的玩家结束行动阶段。
description.en: Phase 4: Action Phase. The phase indicator starts on the first yellow reset space. Players take turns clockwise; each turn must either activate a module (pay exactly 2 activation dice of matching values, or planning/focus markers) or perform a Reset (only if the player has ≤3 activation dice on dice spaces). Reset has three steps — A: Advance the phase indicator along the yellow arrow to the next reset space (if it reaches the red reset-end space, the Action Phase end is triggered); B: Retrieve all used dice and re-roll them; C: Move the leftmost reset marker to the idea space or food space. When the phase indicator reaches the red space, complete the current round, then all players take one final full round, ending with the player right of the starting player.

description.zh: 阶段五：地点阶段。结算与三种地点相关的效果（如已翻开）。
description.en: Phase 5: Site Phase. Resolve effects related to three specific site types (if revealed).

description.zh: 阶段六：喂养阶段。按规则喂饱或饿死部落。营地/船上的部落需 1 食物，野外部落需 2 食物。
description.en: Phase 6: Feeding Phase. Feed or starve tribes according to the rules: 1 food for tribes on campsites/boats, 2 food for tribes in the wilderness.

description.zh: 阶段七：事件阶段。依次执行：1) 结算天气效果；2) 结算事件牌效果；3) 时代计分；4) 确定新的起始玩家（本阶段得分最高者）。
description.en: Phase 7: Event Phase. Execute in order: 1) resolve weather effect; 2) resolve event card effect; 3) era scoring; 4) determine new starting player (highest scorer this phase).

description.zh: 结算天气效果
description.en: Resolve weather effect

description.zh: 结算事件牌效果
description.en: Resolve event card effect

description.zh: 时代计分
description.en: Era scoring

description.zh: 确定新的起始玩家
description.en: Determine new starting player

description.zh: 阶段八：收入阶段。依次执行：A) 执行收入芯片（从上到下、从左到右）；B) 结算雕像收入（每座雕像按阿格拉恩惠轨当前位置计分）；C) 回收大陆上所有狩猎指示物至展示区；D) 每位玩家从供应堆补满空的重置列。完成后将阶段标记移回阶段一，开始新时代（或进入终局计分）。
description.en: Phase 8: Income Phase. Execute in order: A) Execute income chips top-to-bottom, left-to-right; B) Score statues (each statue scores points based on the Favor of Agera track position); C) Return all hunting tokens from the continent to the display; D) Each player refills empty reset columns with markers from supply. Then return the phase indicator to Phase 1 for the next era (or proceed to final scoring).

description.zh: 终局计分阶段。第四时代收入阶段执行完 A（收入）和 B（雕像计分）后，跳过 C 和 D，将阶段标记放到终局计分轨起点。分三轮计分：第一轮沿终局计分轨逐格结算 9 个计分项（技术/声望/知识/建设/文化/进化/繁荣/人口/扩张），每项用该格下方印的每单位分值计算；第二轮结算控制台阶段分区——每个阶段中的卡牌和芯片按该阶段左侧印的分数计分（阶段 4 和阶段 5 仅在对应 stage tile 已激活时才计分）；第三轮结算 point bonus 卡——每张带分数加成图标的卡牌为其所在列的所有卡牌和收入芯片额外加分。总分最高者获胜。
description.en: Final scoring phase. After the 4th era's Income phase steps A (income) and B (statue scoring), skip C and D. Place the phase indicator on the final scoring track start. Score in three rounds: Round 1 — advance along the final scoring track, scoring each of the 9 categories (Technology/Prestige/Knowledge/Construction/Culture/Evolution/Prosperity/Population/Expansion) using the point value printed below each space. Round 2 — score the stage partition: each chip and card scores the points left of its stage (stages 4 and 5 only score if the corresponding stage tile is active). Round 3 — score point bonus cards: each card with the bonus icon grants extra points for all cards and income chips in its column. Highest total score wins.

description.zh: 第一轮：沿终局计分轨逐项结算 9 个计分项。每项的每单位分值由轨上该格下方印的数字（或被计分板块覆盖时的板块面值）决定。
description.en: Round 1: Score each of the 9 scoring categories along the final scoring track. Points per unit for each category are determined by the printed value below the space (or the scoring tile covering it).

description.zh: 第二轮：控制台阶段分区计分。逐一检查阶段 1-5 中安装的每张卡牌和芯片，按阶段左侧分数计分。阶段 4/5 需对应的 stage tile 已激活才计分。
description.en: Round 2: Score the stage partition. Check each card and chip in stages 1-5, scoring the points left of its stage. Stages 4/5 only score if the corresponding stage tile is active.

description.zh: 第三轮：point bonus 卡计分。每张带加成图标的卡牌为其所在列所有卡牌和收入芯片（含自身）提供额外分数。
description.en: Round 3: Score point bonus cards. Each card with the bonus icon grants extra points for all cards and income chips in its column (including itself).

description.zh: 比较所有玩家的成功点数，最高者获胜。平局时，已执行更多模组升级的玩家胜出；仍平局则按座位顺序（从起始玩家顺时针）先到者胜。
description.en: Compare all players' success points; the highest wins. Tiebreaker: the tied player with more module upgrades wins; if still tied, the tied player earliest in seating order (clockwise from starting player) wins.

description.zh: 投掷玩家持有的全部 <fate_die>，并根据 <favor_of_ager_track> 当前位置判定是否通过。只要有一颗骰子的点数落在轨道允许的范围内，即视为通过。常用于模组升级后的额外行动。
description.en: Roll all <fate_die> and check whether any result falls within the allowed range per <favor_of_ager_track> position. Passing requires at least one die to show an allowed value. Commonly used for bonus actions after upgrading modules.

description.zh: 从控制台层级分区中选择 1 个已安装的 <income_chip>，激活其 <ontology::effect>。
description.en: Choose 1 installed <income_chip> from the console stage partition and activate its <ontology::effect>.

description.zh: 选择 1 个可用的 <activity> 并激活。
description.en: Choose 1 available <activity> and activate it.

description.zh: 将手牌中的一张 <research_card> 安装到层级分区。需确定安装列与位置、满足费用格条件。
description.en: Install a <research_card> from hand into the stage partition. Must determine column and position, and satisfy cost slot conditions.

description.zh: 确定安装位置。若尚无同类型，任选空列或仅含 <income_chip> 的列；若已有同类型，选该列最低空位。
description.en: Determine install position. If no card of same type, choose an empty column or one with only <income_chip>s; otherwise use the lowest empty slot in that column.

description.zh: 确定费用范围。N = 安装层级序号，可选更多至 M（M ≥ N，M ≤ 5），前缀连续覆盖。
description.en: Determine cost range. N = tier index, may satisfy up to M (M ≥ N, M ≤ 5), contiguous prefix.

description.zh: 将一枚 <goal_chip> 从目标区安装到层级分区。翻至背面，选左/右半侧，安装至最低空位。
description.en: Install a <goal_chip> from the goal area into the stage partition. Flip to back, choose left/right half, place at lowest empty position.

description.zh: 将一枚 <income_chip> 安装到 <stage_partition>。任选一列，安装至最低空闲 <tier>。
description.en: Install an <income_chip> into the <stage_partition>. Choose any column, install at lowest empty <tier>.

description.zh: 将一枚 <attribute_chip> 安装到 <stage_partition>。若已有同列则继续该列，否则任选空列。
description.en: Install an <attribute_chip> into the <stage_partition>. Continue existing column or choose any empty one.

description.zh: 将 1 个 <food> 从 <food_space> 返回供应堆。
description.en: Return 1 <food> from <food_space> to the supply.

description.zh: 将 1 个 <tribe> 从 <continent> 返回玩家供应堆。
description.en: Return 1 <tribe> from the <continent> to the player's supply.

description.zh: 从 5 条进程轨中任选 1 条推进。
description.en: Choose any 1 of the 5 progress tracks and advance on it.

description.zh: 事件阶段天气标记移动完成后，所有玩家按座次顺位逐一结算当前天气格的效果。正面效果可放弃，负面效果必须执行。
description.en: After weather indicator moves in Event phase, all players in seating order resolve the current weather slot effect. Positive effects may be forgone; negative effects are mandatory.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 事件阶段（Phase 7）天气标记移动完成后
<ontology::condition>.en: After weather indicator movement in Event phase (Phase 7)

<ontology::instant_content>.zh: 所有玩家按座次顺位逐一结算当前天气格效果。
<ontology::instant_content>.en: All players in seating order resolve the current weather slot effect one by one.

description.zh: 选择一个未达最高等级的主模组提升 1 级。L1→L2 翻面，L2→L3 板块放回游戏盒、console 上 L3 效果激活。
description.en: Choose a main module not at max level, increase by 1. L1→L2 flip tile; L2→L3 return tile to game box, console L3 effect becomes available.

description.zh: 选择一个未达等级三的主模组。
description.en: Choose a main module not yet at level 3.

description.zh: 若为等级一，将模组板块翻至等级二面。
description.en: If level 1, flip module tile to level 2 side.

description.zh: 若为等级二，将模组板块放回 <ontology::game_box>。
description.en: If level 2, return module tile to <ontology::game_box>.

description.zh: 获得 1 个收入芯片并触发其效果。
description.en: Gain 1 income chip and trigger its effect.

description.zh: 交易行动。出售仓库材料换取钱币或分数，或用钱币购买新材料。可从以下选项中任选组合执行（顺序任意）：
description.en: The Trade action. Sell stored materials for money or points, or purchase new materials with money. Choose any combination (any order):

description.zh: 出售：从仓库选最多 2 个材料，一个可换钱币，一个可换 2 分。二者不可重复。
description.en: Sale: Sell up to 2 materials. One may be for money, one for 2 points. Cannot double up.

description.zh: 换钱币：售出一个材料换取钱币。
description.en: For money: Sell one material for money.

quantity.zh: 由材料行决定：第一行 1、第二行 2、第三行 3
quantity.en: Determined by material row: row 1 = 1, row 2 = 2, row 3 = 3

description.zh: 换分数：售出一个材料换取 2 分。
description.en: For points: Sell one material for 2 points.

description.zh: 获得 2 分
description.en: Gain 2 success points

description.zh: 购买：支付钱币，从供应堆获取一个材料标记放入仓库。
description.en: Purchase: Pay money, then take one material marker from supply into storage.

description.zh: 幸运收获：选择一种领地类型（该领地中至少有一个你的部落），投掷全部粉色命运骰，选一颗骰子的点数。根据点数和所选领地类型，在仓库区对应的连线找到获得的材料，从供应堆取一个标记放入对应仓库格。
description.en: Make a lucky find: Choose a territory type where you have at least one tribe, roll all pink fate dice, choose one result. The result combined with the territory type determines the material via connecting lines on the storage area; place a marker from supply onto that storage space.

description.zh: 至少有一种领地类型拥有至少一个自己的<tribe>。
description.en: At least one territory type has at least one of your <tribe>s.

triggers.target: 一种至少有一个自己<tribe>的领地类型

description.zh: 投掷全部粉色命运骰。玩家可消耗创意标记修改任意骰子点数（1 和 6 相连）。
description.en: Roll all pink fate dice. Player may spend idea markers to change any die value (1 and 6 are adjacent).

description.zh: 根据玩家选择的领地类型和骰子点数，按仓库区连线对应的材料，从供应堆取 1 个标记放入对应仓库格。
description.en: Based on the player's chosen territory type and die result, take 1 marker of the material indicated by the storage area's connecting lines from supply into the matching storage space.

description.zh: 建造农场：选一个有自己部落的陆地区域（不能已有农场，不能与已翻开的火山相邻），将控制台农场供应堆的一个农场放至该区域。无需材料费用。立即获得 1 个创意标记。最多 3 个，不可主动拆除。
description.en: Build a farm: Choose a land territory where you have at least one tribe, no farm exists (any player), and not adjacent to a face-up Volcano. Take a farm from the console farm supply and place it on the territory. No material cost. Immediately gain 1 idea marker. Max 3 per player; cannot be voluntarily demolished.

description.zh: 存在一片陆地区域（非水域）：有至少一个自己的<tribe>、没有任何<farm>（任何玩家）、不与已翻开的<volcano>相邻。
description.en: There exists a land territory (not Water): has at least one of your <tribe>s, no <farm> (any player), not adjacent to a face-up <volcano>.

description.zh: 控制台<farm_supply>中还有未建造的<farm>（已建造 < 3）。
description.en: <farm_supply> on the console still has an unbuilt <farm> (built < 3).

triggers.target: 有自己的<tribe>且没有任何<farm>的一片陆地区域，且不与已翻开的<volcano>相邻

description.zh: 建造聚落：选一个建造点，从控制台聚落区选一个未建造的聚落，支付其材料费用，将聚落放至建造点。立即获得 1 个收入芯片并触发其效果。建造第 4 个聚落时可翻面一个未激活的层级板块。
description.en: Build a settlement: Choose a Building ground, choose an unbuilt settlement from the console settlement zone, pay its material cost, and place it on the Building ground. Immediately gain 1 income chip and trigger its effect. When building the 4th, may flip an inactive stage tile.

description.zh: 存在一个<building_slot>：与有自己<tribe>的区域相邻、且上面尚未建造自己的<settlement>。
description.en: There exists a <building_slot> adjacent to a territory with your <tribe> and without your own <settlement> on it.

description.zh: 控制台<settlement_zone>中还有未建造的<settlement>（已建造 < 4）。
description.en: <settlement_zone> on the console still has an unbuilt <settlement> (built < 4).

quantity.zh: 2 或 3，因所选聚落格而异：格 1 需 1 木头+1 纸莎草（2 个），格 2 需 1 纸莎草+1 石头（2 个），格 3 需 1 木头+1 石头+1 黏土（3 个），格 4 需 1 沙子+1 铁矿+1 黏土（3 个）。
quantity.en: 2 or 3, varies by settlement slot: slot 1 costs 1 Wood+1 Papyrus (2), slot 2 costs 1 Papyrus+1 Stone (2), slot 3 costs 1 Wood+1 Stone+1 Clay (3), slot 4 costs 1 Sand+1 Iron+1 Clay (3).

triggers.target: 一个与有自己的<tribe>区域相邻的<building_slot>，且上面尚未建造自己的<settlement>

description.zh: 获得 1 个收入芯片并立即触发其效果。若是第 4 个聚落，可额外将层级四或层级五板块翻至激活面。
description.en: Gain 1 income chip and immediately trigger its effect. If 4th settlement, may additionally flip a stage-4 or stage-5 tile to its active face.

description.zh: 建造船：选一个与有自己部落区域相邻的水域（不能已有自己的船），将控制台船供应堆的一艘船连带着船上的标记放至该水域。无需材料费用。立即将相邻区域中的一个站立部落迁徙到船上。最多 2 艘，不可主动拆除。
description.en: Build a boat: Choose a Water territory adjacent to a territory where you have at least one tribe and where you have no boat. Take a boat from the console boat supply (with its markers) and place it on the Water territory. No material cost. Immediately move one standing tribe from an adjacent territory onto the boat. Max 2 per player; cannot be voluntarily demolished.

description.zh: 存在一片水域：与有自己<tribe>的区域相邻、且该水域中没有自己的<boat>。
description.en: There exists a Water territory adjacent to a territory with your <tribe> and without your own <boat> on it.

description.zh: 控制台<boat_supply>中还有未建造的<boat>（已建造 < 2）。
description.en: <boat_supply> on the console still has an unbuilt <boat> (built < 2).

triggers.target: 一个与有自己的<tribe>区域相邻的<terrain_water>，且上面没有自己的<boat>

description.zh: 从相邻区域中选一个站立<tribe>，迁徙到刚放置的<boat>上。只有站立部落才能登船。
description.en: Choose a standing <tribe> from an adjacent territory and migrate it onto the newly placed <boat>. Only standing tribes may board.

description.zh: 建造雕像：选一个建造点（满足建造要求、未超建筑上限），从建造点上列出的 2~3 种材料中选一种，从仓库取出一个对应标记作为雕像放至建造点。可立即推进任意进程轨 1 格。每个建造点最多 2 个建筑（至多 1 个聚落），雕像在后续收入阶段按阿格拉恩惠轨计分。
description.en: Build a statue: Choose a Building ground (meeting building requirements, within build limit). Choose one of the 2-3 materials listed on it, take a marker of that type from storage, and place it as a statue on the Building ground. May immediately advance on any progress track by 1 step. Max 2 buildings per Building ground (max 1 settlement); each statue scores in subsequent Income phases based on the Favor of Agera track.

description.zh: 建造点与有自己<tribe>的区域相邻（若为水域建造点，则需该水域有自己的<boat>且船上有<tribe>）。
description.en: The Building ground is adjacent to a territory with your <tribe> (for Water Building ground, requires your <boat> with a <tribe> on it in that Water territory).

description.zh: 该建造点上自己的建筑少于 2 个。
description.en: You have fewer than 2 of your own buildings on this Building ground.

description.zh: 仓库中有该建造点上列出的至少一种<stored_material>。
description.en: At least one of the <stored_material> types listed on this Building ground is in your storage.

description.zh: 从建造点上列出的 2~3 种材料中选一种，将对应<stored_material>从仓库返还供应堆。
description.en: Choose one of the 2-3 materials listed on the Building ground, and return the corresponding <stored_material> from storage to the supply.

triggers.target: 一个满足建造要求的<building_slot>，且其上列出的材料中至少有一种在仓库中

description.zh: 从供应堆取 1 个通用标记（<octagonal_pillar>）放至建造点，成为<statue>。
description.en: Take 1 generic marker (<octagonal_pillar>) from the supply and place it on the Building ground as a <statue>.

description.zh: 任选一条进程轨推进 1 格。
description.en: Advance on any progress track by 1 step.

description.zh: 完成一个建造项目：从四种建造中选一种执行——建造农场、建造船、建造雕像、或建造聚落。
description.en: Complete a building project: Choose one of four building types to execute — build a farm, build a boat, build a statue, or build a settlement.
